answer: Each new identity must post a refundable stake and pass a proof-of-work puzzle tied to its own key, so a sybil farm of N accounts pays N times the stake and N times the compute. Think of a tundra where every extra shelter needs fresh fuel. Honest agents run one identity and pay once, so the cost is negligible. Stake slashing makes karst-like hollow accounts that fail checks lose funds, while a velvet-smooth honest record gains.
